role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 当维萨吉的夺命佣兽在战场上四处侦察时，他将自己包藏在护甲中，寻找着战机。一旦周围出现战斗，他从附近战士所受的伤害中收集灵魂能量，再将其释放，完成毁灭性一击。
hero_summary_en: As his deadly familiars scout the field, Visage cloaks himself in armor and seeks the next battle. Once near a skirmish, he gathers soul energy from damage inflicted upon nearby fighters before releasing it in a devastating attack.

abilities.name: visage_grave_chill
abilities.description_zh: 维萨吉吸取目标单位的移动和攻击速度，自身和附近的佣兽获得等量加成。
abilities.description_en: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.
notes_zh: 两个状态效果是分开驱散的。
速度加成和目标的速度减少相互独立。
维萨吉周围%radius%内的佣兽也将获得黄泉颤抖的加成效果。
notes_en: The two buffs can be removed separately by dispels.
The speed gained is independent of the speed lost on the target.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will also receive bonuses from Grave Chill.

abilities.name: visage_soul_assumption
abilities.description_zh: 每次附近英雄（不论敌我）受到的伤害超过%damage_limit%点，维萨吉就能集聚灵魂精华的能量。将精华释放后，会对目标单位造成基础伤害，每一点集聚的能量还将造成额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than %damage_limit% damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
notes_zh: 能量点数只计算来自玩家或肉山的伤害，必须大于%damage_min%点小于%damage_max%点。自残型伤害和灵魂超度造成的伤害不计算在内。
notes_en: Charges are only gained for damage greater than %damage_min% and less than %damage_max% that is dealt by a player or Roshan.  Self-damage or Soul Assumption damage isn't counted.
facet_text_en: Soul Assumption kills give %bonus_soul_charge_gold% gold per soul charge, up to %bonus_gold_max_tooltip% gold. Reduced gold from creeps. Enemy heroes killed within %gold_grace_period_hero%s of being affected by Soul Assumption also give gold.
facet_text_zh: 灵魂超度击杀时每点灵魂能量会提供%bonus_soul_charge_gold%金，最高为%bonus_gold_max_tooltip%金。击杀非英雄时获得的金钱有所减少。灵魂超度作用于敌方英雄后%gold_grace_period_hero%秒内英雄阵亡也会获得金钱。

abilities.name: visage_gravekeepers_cloak
abilities.description_zh: 维萨吉产生数层屏障来保护他，降低受到的伤害。每当他受到来自玩家的伤害，就会失去一层屏障，失去的屏障需要一定时间才能恢复。维萨吉的佣兽在%radius%范围内也会受到斗篷的保护，承伤降低的数值取决于维萨吉拥有的层数。
abilities.description_en: Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage.  If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
notes_zh: 每次维萨吉受到来自其他玩家的伤害超过最小伤害时，保护层就会移除一层。
佣兽在维萨吉周围%radius%范围内将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
notes_en: Each time Visage receives damage greater than the Minimum Damage that was not self-inflicted and was from a player owned source, a layer is removed.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will receive the current damage reduction from Gravekeeper's Cloak.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

shard_loc.en: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds.  Restores up to %shard_hp_restoration_pct%%% of your health.
shard_loc.zh: 获得主动效果，维萨吉可以化作石像形态，对身边375范围内的敌人造成0.8/1.0/1.2秒眩晕，同时造成60/100/140点伤害，获得6秒无敌状态。最多恢复%shard_hp_restoration_pct%%%生命值。

abilities.name: visage_silent_as_the_grave
abilities.description_zh: 维萨吉获得飞行移动状态和移动速度加成。攻击或施法后，将失去移速加成和飞行移动状态，同时维萨吉和他的佣兽在%bonus_duration%秒内拥有额外攻击力。
abilities.description_en: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for %bonus_duration%s.

scepter_loc.en: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.
scepter_loc.zh: 移动速度、额外攻击力和持续时间提升。维萨吉和佣兽在持续时间内为隐身状态，直到失去飞行移动状态。

abilities.name: visage_summon_familiars
abilities.description_zh:
召唤%familiar_count%只盲眼的佣兽为维萨吉作战。佣兽拥有石像形态技能，可以化为石像，在落地时使敌人眩晕。在石像形态中的佣兽无敌，并且迅速回复生命值。佣兽被击杀时给予高额奖励。

技能可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，在此期间佣兽无法攻击或行动。
abilities.description_en:
Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
notes_zh: 施放召唤佣兽后已有的佣兽将会死亡。
佣兽在维萨吉周围时将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果和黄泉颤抖的加成效果。
notes_en: Casting Summon Familiars will replace any existing Familiars.
Familiars within range of Visage will receive bonuses from Gravekeeper's Cloak and Grave Chill.
facet_text_en: The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.

Familiars will automatically attack the target Visage tried to attack last, and will return if that target is out of Visage's attack range, or Visage issues the cancel current action or hold position commands.

The ability can be toggled to the Auto-Cast state to command the Familiars to return to Visage and not leave his side until the state has been disabled.
The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
facet_text_zh: 技能可以设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，期间他们无法攻击或行动。

佣兽会攻击维萨吉最后尝试攻击的目标，如果目标超出了维萨吉的攻击距离，或者维萨吉下达了取消当前动作或固守原地的命令后，佣兽会返回。

技能可以设为自动施法，命令佣兽回到维萨吉身旁，在技能关闭前不会离开。
技能可以设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，期间他们无法攻击或行动。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_visage_3
talents_raw.desc_loc: A second Soul Assumption is launched towards a random enemy unit within the cast range, prioritizing Heroes.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_visage_1
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_armor_reduction_per_hit} Armor Corruption to Visage and Familiars
talents_raw.desc_loc: This effect can stack among multiple sources and lasts {s:bonus_armor_reduction_duration}s.
